children: PMGC Holdings secured a binding, interest-bearing payment agreement converting its 5% Elevai Skincare royalty into scheduled monthly cash payments.
Payment agreement acknowledges $94,937 2025 royalty, accruing interest at WSJ Prime + 1.00% from April 2026 until paid.
Structured monthly installments of $10,000 begin Oct 15, 2026, with all amounts due by Aug 28, 2031.
Agreement covers the 2025 royalty and all future royalties/earnouts on same interest-bearing terms.
Longevity’s obligations are absolute and joint & several with the Elevai buyer; no setoff or deduction allowed.
Mandatory 15% prepayments from qualifying capital events, annual audit rights, and acceleration on default provide enforcement.
